decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
Reason: To accord with the provisions of Section 18(1) of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation areas) Act 1990.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [Unnumbered Location Plan, Unnumbered proposed site plan, external and internal photographs. Received: 10/08/2025
Design, Access and Heritage Statement. Received: 09/11/2025].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good for the retained fabric, shall match the original work in type, colour, texture, profile and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution, including facebond and pointing. 
Reason: In order to safeguard the special architectural or historic features of the listed building (and/or the character of the Conservation Area).
description:
There is currently damp in the shared hallway of the property, due to water entering through gaps and perished pointing externally. Proposed works to remedy:

Internally (in Entrance Hallway):
•	Carefully cut out the compromised section of plaster and render back to sound original brickwork.
•	Apply a breathable damp-proof solution suitable for historic masonry (ensuring minimal impact on original materials).
•	Re-render using a compatible damp-proofed sand-cement mix and finish with a skim coat of plaster to match the original smooth finish—respecting existing profiles, textures, and architectural detailing. Repaint with existing colours.

Externally (Affected Wall next to Entrance door and small area above Entrance door):
•	Fully prepare and carefully repoint the brickwork using a weather-struck finish to match existing joint profiles, employing traditional mortar proportions 1/3 sand, cement and lime to ensure breathability and visual consistency.
